title: Wrists and legs
notes: Two new equipment slots, Wrists and Legs, with 16 new pieces: bracers, shorts, kilts and guards.
They drop like the rest of your gear and can be socketed, but they don't show on your character.

title: Shoulders slot
notes: The shoulders slot on the character panel is now as big as the gloves and boots slots.

title: Self-updating game
notes: The game now updates itself: new versions download when you connect, and the game restarts into them. No more installing the APK each time.
The phone version starts much faster.
Shoulders slot and 12 shoulder pieces, shown on your character.
One-handed crossbows with their own shooting animation.
Two-handed weapons, spears and daggers have their own animations.
Change how your armour and weapons look at the Dyer, using looks you have picked up. Unique items have their own looks.
The Gambler, Lucky Mott, sells unidentified items and restocks every so often.
Skill gems are chosen from dropdowns; drag gems onto items to socket them; drag an item to the empty screen to drop it.
